simple.meaning: to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)

definitions.short: to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)
definitions.full: H6279. athar I. [ עָתַר ] verb pray, supplicafe (always to God) (compare Arabic slaughter for sacrifice De Gn (4) 381 We Skizzen iii. 115, 166; Heid. (2). 118, 142 ; RS Sem i. 210 f.; 2nd ed.; 227 f. ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular לי ׳וַיֶעְתַּר Gen 25:21 , ׳אֶליֿ Exod 8:26 ; 10:18 ; Judg 13:8 ; אֶלאֱֿלוֺהַּ יֶעְתַּד Job 33:26 . Niph`al be supplicated, entreated (and grant entreaty; always of God), usually with ל of worshipper (see ל 5d ): Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive לָהֶם וְנֶעְתַּר Isa 19:22 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular לוֺ וַיֵּעָ֫תֶר Gen 25:21 ; 2Chr 33:13 , לָנוּ וַיֵּעָתֵר Ezra 8:23 ; with לָאָרֶץ for the land 2Sam 21:14 ; 24:25 ; Infinitive absolute וְנַעְתּוֺר לָהֶם 1Chr 5:20 ; construct (as substantive) הֵעָתֶרלֿוֺ 2Chr 33:19 . Hiph`il = Qal , make supplication , with לְ אֶל, : Perfect אֶליֿ ׳וְהַעְתַּרְתִּ֫י Exod 8:25 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular אֵלָיו תַּעְתִּיר Job 22:27 ; Imperative masculine plural אֶליֿ ׳הַעְתִּירוּ Exod 8:4 ; 9:28 , ׳לי 10:17 ; also with ל person in behalf of whom, Imperfect 1singular לְךָ אַעְתִּיר 8:5 , so Imperative חַעְתִּירוּ , with בַּעֲדִי 8:24 .
